definition:
Based on random choice, whim, or personal preference rather than reason, rule, or system. (negative)

Critics argued that the new zoning boundaries were arbitrary and lacked any clear rationale.

Done consciously and intentionally, or carried out slowly and carefully rather than hastily. (neutral)

The author's deliberate pacing allows readers to absorb each argument fully.

Showing controlled, methodical behavior achieved through training or self-restraint. (positive)

Her disciplined approach to research allowed her to complete the project ahead of schedule.

Rejected or refused to consider something as unworthy of serious attention. (negative)

The committee dismissed the proposal without reviewing its supporting data.

Praised enthusiastically and at length. (positive)

Critics extolled the novel's intricate structure and moral depth.

Relying on a superficial trick or novelty rather than genuine substance or merit. (negative)

Some reviewers found the film's twist ending gimmicky rather than meaningful.

Occurring as a minor accompaniment or by-product of something else, rather than as its central purpose. (neutral)

The researchers noted that the finding was incidental to the main objective of the study.

Featuring new ideas, methods, or approaches not previously tried. (positive)

The laboratory is known for its innovative techniques in gene editing.

Failed to notice, consider, or take into account. (negative)

Early reviewers overlooked the flaws in the study's methodology.
